$comment: Shared Avatar bindings, used by every theme. Avatar binds its shape as a raw 50% and its outline to the palette; these make both reachable. Defaults are Spectrum's own values.

bindings.reason: Spectrum hard-codes a circle. A brand may want rounded squares.
The image is clipped to the same shape.
Spectrum binds the outline ring to gray-25, used far beyond Avatar.

defaults.name: theme-avatar-radius
defaults.reason: Spectrum's circle. Default; a theme overrides it to change this.

defaults.name: theme-avatar-outline
defaults.reason: Spectrum's outline ring. Default; a theme overrides it to change this.
